market_question: Ukraine agrees not to join NATO before 2027?
reasoning: Given the ongoing war and potential peace negotiations under a Trump administration, Ukraine may agree to a temporary prohibition on NATO membership as part of a deal. The resolution criteria are permissive—any duration or unilateral pledge qualifies—making a Yes plausible. I assess a 35% probability, well above the market's 19%, indicating Yes is undervalued.
evidence_points: Trump’s stated desire to end the war quickly increases pressure on Ukraine to make concessions.
Russia's core demand is Ukrainian neutrality; a limited NATO moratorium could meet that in negotiations.
Ukraine’s leadership has shown some flexibility in private talks, while the broad resolution rules capture even symbolic pledges.
sources_consulted: Foreign Affairs analysis of possible peace scenarios
Recent BBC and Reuters articles on diplomatic tracks
